notes:
Indicates the commencement of work, classes, or business operations. Composed of {始|し} (begin) and {業|ぎょう} (work, business). Used in both workplace and school settings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {始業|しぎょう}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: starting time
- ⟦{始業式|しぎょうしき}→始業式：08555_shigyoushiki⟧: opening ceremony (for a school term)
- {始業|しぎょう}⟦ベル→ベル：01379_beru⟧: start-of-class bell
- {始業|しぎょう}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: before the start of work/class

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{終業|しゅうぎょう}→終業：18204_shuugyou⟧: end of work/class — the opposite
- ⟦{開業|かいぎょう}→開業：14570_kaigyou⟧: opening a business — starting a new business or practice
- {就業|しゅうぎょう}: working, employment — refers to being engaged in work in general
